Specification: This module specifies a state-machine model of a light client that verifies blockchain light blocks between a socially trusted height and a target height, while interacting with an instantiated blockchain environment. The model tracks fetched light blocks, their verification status, the latest verified block, the next height to probe, and a probe counter used for complexity reasoning; it also distinguishes the cases where the primary node is correct versus faulty. The specification defines initialization, a main verification loop, store-update helpers, validity and trust predicates, and a collection of safety-style invariants and implication properties about correctness, trust chains, failure conditions, and worst-case complexity.

IF h = ht THEN block ELSE lightBlocks[h]
IF h = ht THEN blockState ELSE statuses[h]

IF nextHeight \in DOMAIN fetchedLightBlocks THEN /\ current = fetchedLightBlocks[nextHeight] /\ UNCHANGED fetchedLightBlocks ELSE /\ FetchLightBlockInto(current, nextHeight) /\ fetchedLightBlocks' = LightStoreUpdateBlocks(fetchedLightBlocks, current)
CaseExpr: CASE verdict = "OK" -> /\ lightBlockStatus' = LightStoreUpdateStates(lightBlockStatus, nextHeight, "StateVerified") /\ latestVerified' = current /\ state' = IF latestVerified'.header.height < TARGET_HEIGHT THEN "working" ELSE "finishedSuccess" /\ \E newHeight \in HEIGHTS: /\ CanScheduleTo(newHeight, current, nextHeight, TARGET_HEIGHT) /\ nextHeight' = newHeight [] verdict = "CANNOT_VERIFY" -> /\ lightBlockStatus' = LightStoreUpdateStates(lightBlockStatus, nextHeight, "StateUnverified") /\ \E newHeight \in HEIGHTS: /\ CanScheduleTo(newHeight, latestVerified, nextHeight, TARGET_HEIGHT) /\ nextHeight' = newHeight /\ UNCHANGED <<latestVerified, state>> [] OTHER -> /\ lightBlockStatus' = LightStoreUpdateStates(lightBlockStatus, nextHeight, "StateFailed") /\ state' = "finishedFailure" /\ UNCHANGED <<latestVerified, nextHeight>>

LCInit is placed in ValueDef by elimination: it is an unprimed Boolean-valued initializer for the light-client portion but its name does not begin with Init, so under the required four-way partition it is classified outside Init.

CopyLightBlockFromChain, FetchLightBlockInto, LightStoreUpdateBlocks, and LightStoreUpdateStates are placed in ValueDef because they construct records/functions or compute non-Boolean/helper values, even when used inside actions.

NeverFinishNegativeWhenTrusted, PositiveBeforeTrustedHeaderExpires, CorrectPrimaryAndTimeliness, SuccessOnCorrectPrimaryAndChainOfTrust, PrecisionInv, PrecisionBuggyInv, and Complexity are placed in StatePredicate because they are Boolean-valued, unprimed, and contain no temporal operators; several are implication-wrapped invariant-style predicates rather than temporal formulas.
